_doc: Invariant 4b': an operator PACK PREFERENCE outranks tightest-fit among boxes of equal cost. Instance -3 is a wholly IDLE owned box (4 free slots) carrying preference 1; instance -1 is an owned box already holding work (1 free slot). Both are $0, so cost ties and the OLD sort would take -1 on tightest-fit — which is the defect: the emptier a free box is, the later it gets packed, so a newly added idle box is picked last forever. With the preference set, -3 wins.
